senses.sense_definition: Having unlimited power, force or authority.

examples.text: Many ancient myths describe gods as <w>omnipotent</w> beings who control the fate of humanity.
The dictator acted as if he were <w>omnipotent</w>, ignoring all laws and constitutional limits.

senses.sense_definition: Capable of developing into any type of cell or forming any type of tissue.

examples.text: Scientists are researching how <w>omnipotent</w> stem cells can be used to repair damaged organs.
An <w>omnipotent</w> cell has the unique potential to differentiate into any specialized cell in the body.

senses.sense_definition: Utter or complete, often used to emphasize a negative quality.

examples.text: The politician was guilty of <w>omnipotent</w> arrogance during the entire press conference.
His <w>omnipotent</w> foolishness led to the collapse of the entire project.

senses.sense_definition: A title for God, referring to his unlimited power.

examples.text: Believers often pray to the <w>Omnipotent</w> for guidance and strength in difficult times.
The ancient text describes the <w>Omnipotent</w> as the creator of all things in the universe.

senses.sense_definition: A being that possesses unlimited power.

examples.text: In many fantasy novels, the protagonist eventually encounters an <w>omnipotent</w> who challenges their morality.
The story explores the loneliness felt by an <w>omnipotent</w> who has seen everything throughout history.
